contactModel.scope: Passive native surface lattice: independently compressible box faces and translating curved surface cells backed by smaller hard cores. Springs and damping transfer collision reactions to free articulated bones; all cells retain actual position and velocity. This is a coarse engineering approximation, not volumetric anatomical skin, calibrated tissue or muscle simulation. Verified limb vertices use padded convex hulls with inward-offset hard cores. Feet divide the same outer convex volume into heel and medial/lateral forefoot cells for independent native load accommodation; the measured head and trunk use four disjoint anterior/posterior and left/right cells. Other measured segments use one three-axis passive shell. These compact cells can translate and shear but do not represent independent local compression on every opposing surface.
contactModel.assumptions: Layer thickness up to 8 mm (4 mm hands/feet), stiffness 50 kN/m per cell (120 kN/m feet), damping time 2 ms, 2% segment mass redistributed to cells, no numerical slide armature. Curved cells permit bounded shear/translation; box faces permit normal compression. Adjacent proxy overlap is deliberately not scored as self-collision. Consumers without verified measured source frames retain their declared primitive envelopes; those surfaces do not establish complete source-skin coverage. Measured convex profiles replace limb bounding primitives only for SHA-bound source fixtures. Every sampled majority-weight vertex is enclosed. Supporting planes retain 3 mm padding except the plantar plane, which trims only artificial padding below the observed lowest sole point (explicit zero sole padding). The hard core retains the same 4 mm inward plantar offset. Original segment inertia shapes and total mass are retained; convex collision surfaces do not silently refit mass or bone positions. Each plantar cell retains 120 kN/m stiffness and 4 mm travel, with tissue mass shared between the three cells. Shared internal partition faces are same-owner exclusions, not extra exterior volume.
